mapper.select: SELECT st.id, st.plan_id AS planId, st.plan_task_id AS planTaskId, st.plan_time AS planTime, st.reality_time AS realityTime, st.task_status AS taskStatus, st.create_time AS createTime, st.create_user AS createUser, st.update_time AS updateTime, st.update_user AS updateUser, st.medium_status AS mediumStatus, st.tenant_id AS tenantId, st.industry_code AS industryCode, st.access_node AS accessNode, st.accept_node AS acceptNode, CONCAT(lt.flight_route_name, st.plan_time) AS planTaskName FROM vm_air_task_t st left join vm_air_plan_t pt on pt.plan_id = st.plan_id left join vm_air_line_t lt on lt.flight_route_id = pt.flight_route_id WHERE st.delete_flag = 0 ORDER BY st.create_time DESC

SELECT pt.device_Code FROM vm_air_plan_t pt INNER JOIN (SELECT plan_id, create_time FROM vm_air_task_t WHERE delete_flag = 0 and is_it_enabled = 0 ORDER BY ABS(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, plan_time, now())) asc LIMIT 1) AS latest_tt ON pt.plan_id = latest_tt.plan_id WHERE pt.delete_flag = 0 ${dataScope} LIMIT 1;

SELECT lt.flight_route_name || ' + ' || t.plan_time AS taskname, dt.device_name deviceName, pt.plan_id as planId FROM vm_air_task_t t JOIN vm_air_plan_t pt ON t.plan_id = pt.plan_id JOIN vm_air_line_t lt ON pt.flight_route_id = lt.flight_route_id JOIN vm_uav_device_info_t dt ON lt.device_code = dt.device_code WHERE t.plan_task_id = #{taskRecordId};

select it.device_name from vm_air_task_t lt left join vm_air_plan_t pt on pt.plan_id = lt.plan_id left join vm_uav_device_info_t it on it.device_code = lt.uav_code COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci where lt.plan_task_id = #{taskRecordId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO vm_air_result_extraction_t ( task_id, video_id, extract_time, extract_count, extract_total_count, extract_status, video_name, task_name, frequency, create_time, create_user, delete_flag, access_node, accept_node, industry_code, tenant_id ) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{videoId}, #{extractTime}, 0, #{extractTotalCount}, '0', #{videoName}, #{taskName}, #{frequency}, now(), #{createUser}, '0', #{accessNode}, #{acceptNode}, #{industryCode},#{tenantId})
mapper.select: SELECT id, task_id, task_name, video_id, video_name, extract_time, frequency, extract_count, extract_total_count, extract_status FROM vm_air_result_extraction_t WHERE delete_flag = '0' and extract_status IN ('0', '1') and video_id = #{id}
SELECT access_node FROM vm_air_task_t WHERE plan_task_id = #{planTaskId}
SELECT t.uav_code FROM vm_air_task_t t left JOIN vm_air_line_t p ON t.flight_route_id = p.flight_route_id WHERE plan_task_id = #{taskRecordId} and t.delete_flag in ('0','1') and p.delete_flag = 0
select plan_task_id as taskRecordId from vm_air_task_t where task_type = 1 and delete_flag = 0
select plan_task_id as taskRecordId from vm_air_task_t where task_type = 0 and delete_flag = 0
select plan_task_id as taskRecordId from vm_air_task_t where delete_flag = 0 and task_main_id = #{taskRecordId}

select a.photo_id from vm_air_refly_task_ref a left join vm_air_task_t b on a.task_record_id = b.plan_task_id where b.delete_flag = 0 and b.task_status = 1 and a.photo_id in
#{item}
select task_record_id from vm_air_refly_task_ref where photo_id = #{photoId}
select photo_id from vm_air_refly_task_ref where task_record_id = #{taskRecordId}

select b.device_code as uavCode, (case when length(IFNULL(rel.device_name, '')) = 0 then b.device_name else rel.device_name end ) as uavName, c.device_code as uavNestCode, (case when length(IFNULL(relnest.device_name, '')) = 0 then c.device_name else relnest.device_name end ) as uavNestName from vm_air_line_t a left join vm_uav_device_info_t b on b.device_code = (SELECT uav_code FROM vm_air_task_t WHERE plan_task_id = #{taskRecordId}) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci left join vm_uav_nest_device_info c on c.device_code = b.uav_nest_code left JOIN vm_tenant_device_common_rel_t relnest ON relnest.device_code = c.device_code and relnest.tenant_id = a.tenant_Id and relnest.industry_code = a.industry_Code and relnest.delete_flag = '0' and relnest.device_type = 4 LEFT JOIN vm_tenant_device_common_rel_t rel ON rel.device_code = b.device_code and rel.tenant_id = a.tenant_Id and rel.industry_code = a.industry_Code and rel.delete_flag = '0' and rel.device_type = 1 where a.flight_route_id = #{flightRouteId} and a.delete_flag = 0

select t.plan_task_id as taskRecordId,t.task_main_id as originalTaskRecordId,r.photo_id as originalId,t.flight_route_id as flightRouteId, t.start_nest_code,t.end_nest_code from vm_air_task_t t left join vm_air_refly_task_ref r on r.task_record_id = t.plan_task_id where t.delete_flag = 0 and t.task_type = 1 and t.task_status = 1 and t.plan_task_id in
#{item}
select photo_id from vm_air_refly_task_ref tr left join vm_air_task_t t on t.plan_task_id = tr.Task_Record_Id where tr.original_Task_Record_Id = #{taskRecordId} and t.task_status = 1

select b.device_code as uavCode,b.device_name as uavName from vm_air_task_t a left join vm_air_plan_t p on a.plan_id = p.plan_id left join vm_uav_device_info_t b on b.device_code = a.uav_code COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci left join vm_uav_nest_device_info c on c.device_code = b.uav_nest_code where a.plan_task_id = #{taskRecordId} and a.delete_flag = 0

SELECT DISTINCT taskrecord_id AS taskRecordId FROM vm_air_line_col_t cl WHERE col_type = CASE #{queryType} WHEN 'img' THEN 4 WHEN 'video' THEN 2 ELSE col_type END AND user_id = #{userId} AND industry_code = #{industryCode};
